correctness.rationale: Removing the single edge of Q_n increases only the missing endpoints Hamming distance from 1 to 3, so powered matrix is H_p+(3^p-1)(e_u e_v^T+e_v e_u^T). Walsh diagonalization and Bernstein integral show strict negative spectrum of H_p on zero-sum for 0<p<1. Even/odd character separation yields a positive rank-one obstruction with exact scalar R_n(p); root between 0 and1, one-dimensional null at equality; Li-Weston strictness propagation gives unique critical exponent and failure above. Centered Schoenberg rank yields dimensions 2^n-1 and 2^n-2. Isometric subface comparison and uniqueness give strict decrease; integral bound for Walsh modes k>=n/2 shows p_n ->0 by dominated convergence. Independent BFS/Walsh/spectrum tests for n=3..5 yielded p3≈.7474072433, p4≈.6477208242, p5≈.5946979926 and near-zero critical projected eigenvalue. Large-n claims rest on analytic proof, not numerics.
